sections.content:
Looking at the current image, all blocks in the right grid are now gray (same color). The handle has moved to a new position (more to the right, near the middle-right of the bar). The level is still not completed.
I've been going in circles. Let me reconsider the entire puzzle from scratch.
Key observations:
1. Left grid: purple cross pattern on gray background
2. Right grid: 3x3 grid of blocks that can be clicked
3. Top bar: movable handle with blue/sky blue colors
4. Green strip on right edge (HUD element?)
What I've learned:
- Clicking on right grid blocks toggles their color
- Clicking on left grid purple dots seems to affect the right grid
- The handle moves when certain actions are taken
- When all cross blocks become the same color (all green), clicking the last one triggers an animation and all blocks turn gray
Maybe the goal is about the handle position, not the block colors. Perhaps I need to move the handle to a specific position that matches something.
Or maybe the goal is to make the right grid match the left grid exactly - meaning purple blocks at cross positions and gray elsewhere. But clicking only produces green or white, not purple.
Wait - maybe I need to use UP/DOWN on the handle to change its color to purple, then click on blocks. Let me try pressing UP or DOWN while the handle is selected.
Actually, let me reconsider. Maybe the handle's two colors (blue and sky blue) represent a "from" and "to" color mapping. The blue part maps to one color and the sky blue part maps to another. Moving the handle changes this mapping.
Let me try a different approach: use UP/DOWN to change the handle's color configuration, then click on blocks.
